company.name: Wright Electric
company.shortDescription: Wright Electric is a leader in the future of sustainable, lower emissions air travel.
company.description: Wright Electric's unique propulsion technology and forthcoming airplanes eliminate emissions without the need for offsets, lowering the cost of zero-emissions flight to the same level as running a fossil-fueled fleet and ushering in the next age of aviation through the electrification of the aerospace sector.

aiResearchSummary.text: Wright Electric is researching lightweight high temperature battery systems using polymer casings that withstand heat from chemically active materials, portable generators integrating electric machines, power converters and housings, waste heat control for aircraft fuel cells with diverter based transfer systems, and aircraft propulsion liquid cooling where electric motors, power electronic modules and AC leads are thermally and electrically integrated; together these efforts target batteries, portable power, heat management and electric propulsion.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Grant round raised $3,342,094, or 80.55% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 3 disclosed grants total $4,029,094, representing 97.11% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,292,652 to $6,992,923, a 3.05x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 77 (+3 over 90 days) and market heat at 57 (-1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
